_comment: Curated evergreen-rescue list: EXISTING /{metro}/event/{slug}/ URLs that ranked (90-day GSC clicks+impressions pulled and SHOWN per ~/Projects/seo-ops/SEO-POLICY.md) and then died in the 410 lifecycle. generate-seo-pages.mjs regenerates each as a permanent 200 recap page at the SAME URL (no Event JSON-LD, no date claims beyond lastHeld), and the event-seo-manifest `evergreen` array exempts the slug from the edge guard's 410. Inclusion bar: ranked-and-dead ONLY — metrics shown first, list stays curated, never systemic. `match` is a case-insensitive regex against live event titles to cross-link next year's edition when it is back in the dataset; recurrence "unverified" entries must not claim the event returns every year. Note: this list is complementary to data/annual-events.json (/{metro}/annual/ guides) — boston minuteman-library-crawl exists in BOTH (annualSlug cross-references it); the /annual/ page is the year-round guide, the /event/ evergreen page preserves the ranked URL itself. Evergreen policy (user directive 2026-08-04): a page that EVER ranked keeps its recap for as long as it draws impressions — evergreen URLs are kept much longer than the 410 lifecycle would, on purpose, to keep attracting search traffic; removal is never the default for a ranked slug (only for pages shown to be zero-traffic, per the metrics-first policy).
